title: Wilson meeting at the EG&G parking lot where Bob Lazar worked

tellings.quote: that meeting took place in the parking lot & which is where Bob Lazar I pretty sure worked

plain: In 2002 a physicist named Eric W. Davis met a senior military officer named Thomas R. Wilson, and the meeting is said to have taken place in the parking lot of EG&G, a defense contractor. A document called the Wilson memo is presented as notes of that conversation. Jesse Michels adds, in a 2024 episode with the filmmaker James Fox, that he is "pretty sure" EG&G is where Bob Lazar worked, a man who says he worked on alien craft, which would tie the meeting to one of the best-known claims in the field.
